_comment: Referral partner registry. `code` is the public ?ref= code in the partner's link; `aliases` are extra vanity spellings. `attio` maps the code to the partner's CRM record. `authorizedEmails` gates the partner portal: only these addresses can request a sign-in link (emailed, 15-min expiry), and sessions die when an address is removed. Set active:false to shut a partner off entirely. Registry is read at build time — changes go live on the next production deploy.
